examples: Parcel-specific contributing survey remains UNKNOWN until EA metadata-index match; no inference from programme block or composite year.
Newest/best-resolution repeat-survey policy is recorded as composite policy, not parcel-specific survey identity.
Bilinear resampling is explicit provenance; resampled composite values are not described as native observations.
WMS/preview is portrayal only; numeric terrain workflow requires WCS/downloaded raster.
Secondary OS Terrain 5 grid values are 5m cell means located at pixel centres, not arbitrary point heights.
Stored decimal precision is never promoted to vertical accuracy.
OS Terrain 5 remains secondary because its product RMSE is metres, not sub-metre primary validation.
Ordinary HMLR title-plan edging remains general-boundary evidence unless determined-boundary evidence exists.
Map scale/plan tolerances are horizontal registration-plan controls and are not elevation uncertainty.
Title plan is read with register/filed documents and may reflect an older OS mapping edition.
A survey-compliant estate plan can meet plotting tolerances without creating an exact registered boundary.
Coverage position/value structure must be internally consistent before sampling; conformance alone is not truth.
Any scaling/reprojection interpolation must be explicit and reproducible; native sample is preferred for primary measurement.
GeoTIFF/netCDF/Coverage encoding conformance does not increase source accuracy or replace lineage checks.
